purpose: Form RSC-6 is the form used for the order confirming a reduction of share capital and approving the minute, including any directions or terms and conditions deemed fit by the Tribunal.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Wait for the Tribunal to make an order confirming a reduction.
Obtain the order confirming the reduction and approving the minute in Form No. RSC-6.
checklist: Confirm the Tribunal has made an order confirming the reduction.
Check that the order includes the approved minute.
Check for any directions or terms and conditions included by the Tribunal.
watch: Ensure the order confirming the reduction of share capital and approving the minute is in Form No. RSC-6.
